quarantine.mr_name: SAM flag bit 0x4 exclusivity violation must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: Every SUT must REJECT (raise error or crash) when FLAG 0x4 is set on a record with RNAME != '*' and POS > 0. Silent acceptance or silent record-drop is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: Bit 0x4 indicates the segment is unmapped. When bit 0x4 is set, RNAME MUST be '*' and POS MUST be 0.

quarantine.mr_name: SAM CIGAR-SEQ length mismatch must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: Every SUT must REJECT when the sum of query-consuming CIGAR operators (M, I, S, =, X) does not equal len(SEQ) and SEQ != '*'. Silent acceptance is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: The sum of lengths of the M/I/S/=/X operations MUST equal the length of SEQ.

quarantine.mr_name: SAM optional tag type character violation must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: Every SUT must REJECT when an optional tag's type character is not one of A, i, f, Z, H, or B. Silent acceptance is a conformance bug.

evidence.quote: The type character MUST be one of A (character), i (integer), f (float), Z (string), H (hex array), or B (general array).

quarantine.mr_name: SAM TLEN sign consistency violation must be rejected
quarantine.oracle: Every SUT must REJECT when both reads of a paired template carry same-signed TLEN values. The spec requires opposite signs for the two mates.

evidence.quote: For paired-end reads, the two reads of a template MUST have equal magnitude but opposite sign TLEN values.
